notes.title: Updated Game Includes Cool New VR Experiences!
notes.content:
Hi all,

We have updated VR Chair Games to include 2 brand new VR Experiences:

Wild Rider: Burn some rubber as you cruise down the highway at breathtaking speeds avoiding oncoming traffic.

Balloons & Arrows: Perfect your targeting skills by shooting down ascending balloons for optimal points.

Have Fun :)
